note: Stock Evaluation Memoir entry, select a source girl, start a fresh map, real map-node touches along the guaranteed connected road to guardian, preview/select/battle/result. Existing hero progression fixture and real Exp-item route only. No model map, fog, carry, verdict or reward assignments and no fabricated result. Native proof separately covers three-floor progression, chests, final award, revival, PvP/recovery/concurrency. The VC scene places lower map cells outside the emulated viewport; the scenario invokes the actual registered NODE_TOUCH_EVENT began/ended callbacks for the source tile, asserting source visibility before every interaction. No map/model, position, fog, event handler or server state is assigned. This proves source callback behavior, not physical Android geometry. The prior fixture genuinely lost against the guardian. This scenario accepts either actual battle outcome and asserts the corresponding canonical carry/map/reward behavior; it does not claim a stock victory. Positive progression and awards have separate native evidence.
steps: lua:local p=xyd.ModelManager.get():loadModel(xyd.ModelType.SELF_PLAYER) for _,h in pairs(p:getHeros()) do local hero=h if hero:getLevel()<xyd.tables.player:heroMaxLev(p.lev) then p:addPartnerExp({item_id=50001005,partner_id=hero:getHeroID(),item_num=100,total_num=p:getBackpack():getItemNumByID(50001005)},function(code,req,reply) if code~=xyd.error.OK or not reply.partner_exp then error('vc-training-failed') end hero:setExp(reply.partner_exp,xyd.tables.player:heroMaxLev(p.lev)) p:getBackpack():setItemNumByID(reply.item_id,reply.total_num) end) end end

lua:local cards={} local function walk(n) if not n:isVisible() then return end if n:getName()=='layout' then table.insert(cards,n) return end for _,c in ipairs(n:getChildren()) do walk(c) end end walk(xyd.WindowManager.get():getWindow('battle_select_team'):nodeByName('list_layer')) for _,card in ipairs(cards) do local b=card:getCascadeBoundingBox() __vc.tap(b.x+b.width/2,b.y+b.height/2) end

lua:local m=xyd.ModelManager.get():loadModel(xyd.ModelType.MEMORIES_OF_SCHOOL) local wm=xyd.WindowManager.get() if not m.baseInfo or m.baseInfo.now_floor~=1 then error('vc-memoir-result-model') end local won=wm:getWindow('battle_win') local lost=wm:getWindow('battle_lose') if not won and not lost then error('vc-memoir-no-terminal-window') end local carried=0 for _,s in pairs(m:getHeroStatus().self_list) do if s.health==1 then carried=carried+1 end end if carried==0 then error('vc-memoir-no-carry') end if won and (m.mapInfo[53]~=0 or m.maxFloorInfo[tostring(m.baseInfo.hero_id)]~=1 or #m.dropsInfo==0) then error('vc-memoir-win-not-applied') end if lost and (m.mapInfo[53]~=2 or #m.dropsInfo~=0) then error('vc-memoir-loss-granted-win') end
